request-prompt: Promote pop culture and lifestyle content by placing the Entertainment column ('Entretenimento') and the reality TV video updates at the top left of the page layout, ahead of the hard news columns.
goal: I enjoy following celebrity gossip, reality show updates, and entertainment news as a lighthearted way to unwind and stay entertained.
jobs: I want to catch up on the most important news of the day in Brazil and around the world.
I want to check the schedule and times of today's football matches.
I want to check the current exchange rates of the US Dollar and Euro, as well as the Ibovespa index.
I want to read the daily horoscope forecast for my zodiac sign.
I want to find out what programs are airing on TV Globo today and at what times.
I want to read celebrity gossip and catch up on the latest entertainment news.
I want to quickly check the weather forecast for my region.
I want to read the weekly summaries and spoilers of my favorite soap operas.

preference-pairs.a: I prefer reading written articles and detailed text reports because they provide more depth and allow me to scan information at my own pace.
preference-pairs.b: I prefer consuming news primarily through short video clips and highlights because they are more engaging and easier to digest.

preference-pairs.a: I enjoy browsing portals with a dense, diverse layout of headlines, columns, and utility widgets to discover random interesting topics.
preference-pairs.b: I feel easily overwhelmed by busy, multi-column portal layouts and prefer minimalist interfaces where I can focus on a single stream of content.

preference-pairs.a: I value serious, objective news like politics, economics, and world events, and I actively filter out sensational celebrity gossip or pop culture drama.
preference-pairs.b: I enjoy following celebrity gossip, reality show updates, and entertainment news as a lighthearted way to unwind and stay entertained.

preference: I enjoy following celebrity gossip, reality show updates, and entertainment news as a lighthearted way to unwind and stay entertained.
